claim: Prominent US Democrat party members including Hillary and Bill Clinton, were running a child sex-trafficking ring in the basement of a Washington, D.C., pizzeria.
justification: High-confidence evidence from multiple sources, including law enforcement agencies like the DC Metropolitan Police and FBI, as well as fact-checking organizations, consistently shows that no credible investigations found evidence of a child sex-trafficking ring operated by Hillary and Bill Clinton at a Washington, D.C., pizzeria. Specifically, investigations confirmed that Comet Ping Pong does not have a basement used for trafficking, and no verifiable links exist between the Clintons and the pizzeria. The single low-confidence evidence item suggesting a basement is contradicted by all high-confidence sources and is discounted as potentially fabricated.
